pages.title: Make Yourself at Home
pages.text: Give a room a seat, storage and a proper bed.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Choose any supported wood for each piece in the recipe view. One placement of each furniture type is enough.

pages.title: Useful to know
pages.text: Compatible fences/walls connect diagonally; some stacked diagonal walls have gaps. Continuous placement helps build straight runs. Mouse drag distributes stacks, Shift-drag transfers and wheel moves individual items. These are controls, not extra quest requirements.
